coach_memory_facts_source_consistency_ch.name: coach_memory_facts_source_consistency_chk
coach_memory_facts_source_consistency_ch.value:
(
        ("coach_memory_facts"."source" = 'CHAT' and "coach_memory_facts"."source_message_id" is not null)
        or
        ("coach_memory_facts"."source" = 'USER_EDIT' and "coach_memory_facts"."source_message_id" is null)
      )

coach_messages_action_consistency_chk.name: coach_messages_action_consistency_chk
coach_messages_action_consistency_chk.value:
(
        ("coach_messages"."action" is null and "coach_messages"."action_status" is null and "coach_messages"."action_result_ref_id" is null)
        or
        ("coach_messages"."action" is not null and "coach_messages"."action_status" in ('PROPOSED', 'ACCEPTED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
      )

coach_profiles_values_chk.name: coach_profiles_values_chk
coach_profiles_values_chk.value:
(
        "coach_profiles"."calibration_status" in ('NOT_STARTED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'SKIPPED')
        and "coach_profiles"."memory_consent" in ('PENDING', 'GRANTED', 'DECLINED')
        and ("coach_profiles"."support_preference" is null or "coach_profiles"."support_preference" in ('EMOTIONAL', 'BALANCED', 'ACTION'))
        and ("coach_profiles"."directness_preference" is null or "coach_profiles"."directness_preference" in ('GENTLE', 'BALANCED', 'DIRECT'))
      )

notebooks_title_check.name: notebooks_title_check
notebooks_title_check.value: ("notebooks"."title" IS NULL AND "notebooks"."kind" = 'MISTAKE') OR char_length("notebooks"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 40

plan_tasks_origin_consistency_chk.name: plan_tasks_origin_consistency_chk
plan_tasks_origin_consistency_chk.value:
(
        ("plan_tasks"."origin_type" is null and "plan_tasks"."origin_ref_id" is null and "plan_tasks"."origin_meta" is null)
        or
        ("plan_tasks"."origin_type" in ('COMMUNITY_COACH', 'AI_COACH') and "plan_tasks"."origin_ref_id" is not null and "plan_tasks"."origin_meta" is not null)
        or
        ("plan_tasks"."origin_type" = 'MENTORSHIP' and "plan_tasks"."origin_ref_id" is not null and "plan_tasks"."origin_meta" is null)
      )

plan_tasks_topic_requires_subject_chk.name: plan_tasks_topic_requires_subject_chk
plan_tasks_topic_requires_subject_chk.value: "plan_tasks"."topic" is null or "plan_tasks"."subject" is not null

promotions_window_order.name: promotions_window_order
promotions_window_order.value: "promotions"."starts_at" is null or "promotions"."ends_at" is null or "promotions"."ends_at" > "promotions"."starts_at"

user_journey_level_celebrations_resoluti.name: user_journey_level_celebrations_resolution_pair_chk
user_journey_level_celebrations_resoluti.value: ("user_journey_level_celebrations"."resolved_at" is null and "user_journey_level_celebrations"."resolution" is null) or ("user_journey_level_celebrations"."resolved_at" is not null and "user_journey_level_celebrations"."resolution" is not null)
